```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
metadata <- read.table("/home/rstudio/mnt_data/MapMet/lazic.imc.2024/metadata/20231128_metadata_complete.csv",
                       sep =",",
                       header = TRUE,
                       row.names = 1)
imc <- readRDS("/home/rstudio/mnt_data/MapMet/lazic.imc.2024/Rds/imc_seurat.rds")
```


```{r}
seu_meta <- imc@meta.data
```

```{r}
seu_meta <- seu_meta %>%
  mutate(Sample = str_extract(sample_id, "[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4,5}"))

# Verify
head(seu_meta %>% distinct(sample_id, Sample))

# Check all match metadata
unmatched <- setdiff(unique(seu_meta$Sample), unique(metadata$Sample))
if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
  warning("These extracted Sample IDs have no match in metadata:\n",
          paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("✓ All Sample IDs match metadata")
}

# Join on Sample + Tissue together — prevents the many-to-many expansion
seu_meta_annot <- seu_meta %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>%
      select(Sample, Tissue, Timepoint) %>%
      distinct(Sample, Tissue, .keep_all = TRUE),  # safety: dedupe metadata side
    by = c("Sample" = "Sample",
           "tissue" = "Tissue")                    # seu_meta$tissue ↔ metadata$Tissue
  )

# Verify row count is preserved exactly
stopifnot(nrow(seu_meta_annot) == nrow(seu_meta))
message("✓ seu_meta_annot rows: ", nrow(seu_meta_annot),
        " | matches expected: ", nrow(seu_meta))

# Check for any cells that didn't get a Timepoint
missing <- seu_meta_annot %>%
  filter(is.na(Timepoint)) %>%
  distinct(Sample, tissue)
if (nrow(missing) > 0) {
  warning("These Sample × tissue combos have no Timepoint in metadata:\n")
  print(missing)
} else {
  message("✓ All cells have Timepoint annotation")
}
```
